editor.title: Theme Customization
editor.subtitle: Real-time multi-tenant theme builder
editor.surface_effect_desc: How every panel in the app is drawn: its fill, edge, blur and shadow.

toast.save_local_only: Theme saved on this device. It could not reach the server, so other devices still see the previous theme.
toast.save_no_local: Theme applied, but it could not be stored on this device. It will be lost on reload.

presets.title: Style presets
presets.description: A complete starting point. Applying one replaces your current settings — you can keep tuning afterwards.

colors.title: Color palette
colors.description: Brand and semantic colors are shared by both modes. Surface and text colors can differ.
colors.brand_gradient_desc: A four-lobe mesh wash built from Primary and Secondary, published as --gradient-brand-mesh. Intensity scales every lobe’s opacity.
colors.mode_toggle_aria: Mode being edited for surface and text colors
colors.mode_fallback_note: A swatch left unset for a mode falls back to its light value — set dark explicitly where the light one would not survive a dark screen.

components.title: Component styles
components.description: Everything follows the global effect unless you override it here.

desc.standard: Solid surfaces with ordinary elevation shadows.
desc.glass: Frosted translucent panels that blur whatever sits behind.
desc.liquid-glass: Frosted glass with saturation, a specular edge and inner light.
desc.neu: Soft extruded relief, lit from one corner.
desc.brutalism: Hard borders and a flat offset drop shadow.
desc.bento: Generously rounded tiles with a hairline edge.
desc.organic: Fluid asymmetric curvature with soft edges.
desc.immersive: Layered depth with perspective and a long shadow.

fieldhint.liquidGlass_blur: How far the frost carries behind the panel
fieldhint.organic_curvature: Above 50 the corners go asymmetric, which is the organic look
fieldhint.organic_fluidity: Softens the whole surface; high values blur its own content
fieldhint.immersive_depth: Drives the length of the projected shadow

glass.title: Glassmorphism
glass.description: Frosted panels: a blurred view of whatever sits behind, with a bright hairline edge.
glass.empty: Turn glassmorphism on to tune blur and tint.
glass.tint_hint: rgba() so the blur behind it stays visible
glass.frosted_caption: How cards read with glassmorphism on
glass.preview_note: Preview ground is fixed so the effect stays readable in both modes; your own surfaces use the tenant background.

neu.title: Neumorphism
neu.description: Soft extruded surfaces: one light shadow and one dark, from a single light source.
neu.empty: Turn neumorphism on to tune depth and light angle.
neu.base_hint: Neumorphism only reads on a surface that matches this color
neu.distance_hint: How far the shadows sit from the shape
neu.light_angle_hint: Elevation of the light above the horizon: 0° lights the surface from the side, 90° from directly above, 45° gives the classic diagonal
neu.extruded_caption: How buttons and cards read with neumorphism on

layout.sidebar_hint: Navigation in a full-width vertical drawer.
layout.collapsed_hint: Vertical drawer pinned to its narrow icon rail.
layout.topbar_hint: Navigation in a horizontal bar under the header.

spacing.title: Spacing, radius & elevation
spacing.description: The scale everything else is built from. Any CSS length works — 8px, 1rem, 0.5em.
spacing.fluid_desc: Viewport-responsive. Use a clamp(min, preferred, max) so layout tightens on small screens and opens up on large ones.
spacing.borders_desc: Line weight and style for every container edge. Any CSS border-width or border-style works.
spacing.border_roles_desc: The colour a border takes by role — a barely-there row divider through to the brand-coloured focus ring. Any CSS colour works.
spacing.elevation_desc: The five shadow steps surfaces use for depth. Any box-shadow value works.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.description: Your tokens on real components, updating as you edit.

card.body: A card as the app draws it. Hover to see the interactive state.

ai.prompt_placeholder: Describe a look — e.g. calm fintech console, deep navy primary, soft neutral surfaces, gently rounded cards
ai.no_styles: No styles in this category yet — describe your own above.
